name: 4st Music Bot
description: Fast Telegram music bot with YouTube streaming and group management.

API_ID.description: Telegram App ID — my.telegram.org → API Development Tools

API_HASH.description: Telegram App Hash — my.telegram.org → API Development Tools

SESSION_STRING.description: Pyrogram session string for the assistant/userbot account. Generate via SESSION_STRING_HELPER.py or @StringFatherBot.

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram numeric user ID — message @userinfobot

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Log channel ID (e.g. -1001234567890). Add bot as admin with post rights.

MUST_JOIN.description: Channel username (no @) users must join to use the bot. Leave empty to disable.

SUPPORT_CHAT.description: Support group invite link shown in /start

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub personal access token with repo write scope — for data persistence across restarts.

BOT_REPO.description: GitHub repo for data sync, e.g. username/reponame.

YOUTUBE_COOKIES.description: YouTube cookies in Netscape format. Export from browser using 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' extension and paste here.

MUSIC_ARCHIVE_CHANNEL.description: Telegram channel ID for media cache. Add bot as admin with post rights.

MAX_QUEUE_SIZE.description: Maximum songs a group can queue at once.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for AI chatbot. Get at: aistudio.google.com/apikey

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify Client ID for Spotify support. Get at: developer.spotify.com/dashboard
